title: Bootstrap a Widget package from a numbered todo list
narrative: Fangore hands a multi-step bootstrap as an ordered instruction list so guided coding classifies list mode and runs a coding burst per todo under shared workspace acceptance. Live Completer is the proof gate; static multi-file stubs are only a provisional mirror. Complements `fangore_instruction_todo_plan` (plan-only) and `fangore_counter_bootstrap` (oneshot package bootstrap).
implementation: Agentic Recipe catalog id `guided_coding` with `environment.local_work: project_coding`, `environment.workspace: suite`, soft point `external_guidance` (choices minimal/thorough), and budget soft point `max_iterations`. List stages pass `instruction_mode: list` into `ProjectCodingLocalWork` / `build_instruction_plan`. Host `verify_runs` include `pytest: true` and `text_contains` / `text_forbids` with repair. Live mode binds `completer_as_tool_loop_complete`; static `coding_writes` are provisional until the live suite passes. MCP `MECHA_MCP_HOST=project_coding` drives the same `DurableGraphGenerator` graph (no separate suite).
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `list_bootstrap.yaml` inside sequential suite `delegate_pkg` (ordered). Live eligibility: `environment.local_work: project_coding`. Do not treat static/cassette green as proof until live Completer on the suite host has passed.
